BL-1829 — Every local-model seat on a 32768-token window is refused at launch since BL-1801, because the qwen CLI's own first-turn overhead (28 tools and its system prompt, about 105,000 characters) exceeds the window before any card; each local-model seat now carries its own .qwen/settings.json allowing only the six tools its loop uses (measured 51,700-55,000 characters), the gate's recorded overhead follows the new measurement, and a 32k coder seat launches again
